question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**deprived**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the health and nutrition status of different groups of children in India.
 
• The blank refers to those sections of children who are most affected by poor nutrition and well-being.
